purpose: Connect four inspected resources to concrete delivered objects and reader decisions.
scope: Previously acquired papers and pinned code; not an exhaustive priority search or inability claim.

items.established_capability: Functionality, invariance and directional tests with reusable test suites.
items.supplied_object: Keyed B/P/R/F center histories and separate evaluator targets, fixed forecasts and crossed losses.
items.reader_decision: Retain lower event-arm error while checking whether changed history helps on the same target.
items.limits: Finite dependent constructed contexts; no causal incident effect or novel decomposition.

items.related_resource: Context is Key, ICML 2025; pinned postpublication source
items.established_capability: Contextual forecasting, context ablations, region scoring and fixed configurations accepting supplied targets.
items.supplied_object: Complete B/P/R/F/C/N numeric histories, four timing groups, two declared targets, all saved model/configuration outcomes.
items.reader_decision: Check total versus conditional other-input response and pooled versus timing judgments using one fixed forecast file.
items.limits: Not claimed as an unavailable CiK capability. The two hourly CiK probes remain separate from the NET-V4 12-to-12 task; numeric slot relations are not measured adjacency.

items.established_capability: Observed traffic/incident data, post-incident forecasting comparisons and same-station prior-day controls.
items.supplied_object: Fixed case/control memberships, strictly pre-report targets, keyed origins and January-frozen forecasts.
items.reader_decision: Inspect a descriptive observed comparison while retaining its separate cohort and time scale.
items.limits: Descriptive supplemental comparison; does not validate the synthetic incident mechanism or establish matching novelty.

items.related_resource: IGSTGNN Contra_Costa v1 release and pinned split script
items.established_capability: Traffic, calendar and incident records plus a documented split script.
items.supplied_object: Source-bound history/future matches, hit/miss losses and per-station support/exclusion witnesses.
items.reader_decision: Name the predictor input key and retain both remaining reuse and empty/nonempty training support.
items.limits: External source not bundled. One region/version, not NET-V4 performance; no published-neural inflation estimate or chronology repair.
